name: superstack
description: Coding agents lose the goal across compactions and cold sessions; superstack keeps it. A per-workspace record carries your goals, corrections, and evidence, surfaced at every session start, and shell hooks fire at the chokepoints whether or not a skill loads: the claims gate bounces a bare done-claim, the publish gate holds a push until a fresh sweep exists. Specialist skills cover the lifecycle from shaping an idea to shipping it.
